races.display_title: Sky Bet Mile Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
races.verdict: The 3-y-o handicap over this trip at Glorious Goodwood looks the key piece of form here. Runner-up ZENNOR STORM was one of several who shaped better than the result and is taken to go one place better this time. Intense Vision and Storming Point are others who very much caught the eye in that Goodwood contest and head the dangers along with Britannia runner-up Outback Heat and Le Samourai , who has snuck in at the bottom of the weights and also bagged the inside stall. ZENNOR STORM INTENSE VISION STORMING POINT

Master Vintner showed the benefit of blinkers when going in at Thirsk last time and rates a big threat with likely more to offer, while the consistent Tycoon can also play a prominent role with Ryan Moore in the saddle. races.verdict: YABHER hails from a top yard and can make amends for his luckless Goodwood effort 24 days ago, where he was denied a run and badly hampered in the final 1f. The step back up in trip should suit and he's preferred to Tiernan , who won a novice here 20 days ago and should prove suited by this longer trip. Salamanca City is thriving and could make an impact upped in grade. YABHER TIERNAN (IRE) SALAMANCA CITY (IRE)
